claim: Formulate risk-aware decisions from natural-language delegation with retained decision-relevant alternatives and no further user interaction
object: State-wise interpretations/events, requirements, consequences, risk permissions and utility; Equations (1)-(4)
evidence: Section 3.1; fixed-set decision principle attributed to RAC
scope: Target decision semantics are defined from the request; compiled semantics may differ and are evaluated end to end. No unique interpretation, new max-min theorem, or conformal calibration is assumed.

claim: Execute purchase, refusal, or failure under the fixed authorization and value policy
object: Generated state-dependent conditions evaluated on a complete finite catalogue
evidence: Section 3.2; Algorithm 1; risk_payment/decision.py; algorithm_contract_check.json (10 deterministic checks)
scope: Exact optimization requires complete catalogue coverage, decided admissibility for every candidate, and known utilities for every admissible candidate. Algorithm 1 returns Fail(uncertified) before selection otherwise.

claim: Improve safe completion on controlled financial boundaries
evidence: DeepSeek exact 248/400 (62.0%) to 369/400 (92.25%); unsafe 79 to 9; false refusal 53 to 1; complete primary configurations and all failures retained. The pooled exactness gain is 30.25 percentage points, with a 95% template-bootstrap interval of [22.75, 37.25].
scope: Architectural Direct/Set comparison; not a representation-only causal effect or deployment incidence estimate
main_location: Figure 1: 11 configurations with n=200 per method; pooled safety/completion over 2200 outcomes and 1100 feasible tasks per method; four contract-family rates for DeepSeek low/high. The appendix gives all 20 DeepSeek template counts.

claim: Characterize scope across model, effort, language and reuse
object: Separate fixed cohorts with explicit denominators
evidence: 11 primary configurations; 18 reported Sol/Terra/Luna reasoning settings; six DeepSeek setting-language comparisons; reuse 175429 to 22160 tokens.
scope: 17/18 displayed reasoning settings improve, with one decline; reported panels retain their own denominators.
main_location: Section 5.5 and Figure 4; full robustness and resource tables in Appendix E.
effort_language_reporting: Figure 4 and Table 18 cover six settings per GPT-5.6 family, off through max. DeepSeek language cells contain 60 tasks.

claim: Test how candidate availability and utility ranking conceal or expose permission errors
object: Frozen-rule replays and offline component interventions
evidence: 648 frozen DeepSeek artifacts, 1296 replays, 23 unsafe domains, 8 unsafe-only selections, and 12 invalid executions per condition. Six reference-assisted interventions on 16 selected faulty outputs.
scope: Diagnostic evidence, not runtime repair or proof of universal semantic fidelity
main_location: Section 4 analysis; Section 5.4, Figure 3, and Table 2; full protocols and counts in Appendix F.

claim: Incorporate author-confirmed results from another computer
object: Updated primary and Astra language aggregate reporting
scope: Raw records pending import; no synthetic trials, error breakdowns, or new paired statistics; original matched controls remain separate

claim: Controlled decisions under retained user-intent ambiguity
scope: Three explicitly signalled semantic families; 66 variants, 616 recorded trials; retrospective, separate cohorts; not open-ended discovery.
diagnostics: One request / 36 input interventions; 16 selected rules omit the Li interpretation.
main_location: Section 5.3, Figure 2, and Table 13 give the four complete intent cohorts. Component interventions are in Table 2 and input interventions in Appendix F.
reporting_units: 544 recorded API outcomes comprise 294 complete paired Direct/Set outcomes, 178 merged-expression controls, and 72 other Direct/Set outcomes. The displayed panel has 147 matched task-configuration units; Appendix D states the relationship.

claim: Summarize the evaluation evidence actually reported in the paper
evidence: Table 1 and the result-to-artifact map in Appendix B.5
scope: Four research questions connect task construction, safe completion, retained intent, semantic diagnostics, and operational checks. Cohorts retain separate denominators.

main_location: Figure 1a and the primary outcome table
scope: Author-confirmed n=200 per method: exact 142 to 194, unsafe 8 to 1, refusal 14 to 1, other 36 to 4, safe completion 76 to 98 of 100 feasible. Earlier pilot and review records remain separate.

claim: Analyze how omitted states affect authorization and guaranteed value
object: Reference domains and worst-case values under a nonempty retained subset of states
evidence: Section 4.2, Equation (6); direct consequences of intersection and infimum monotonicity
scope: All remaining state functions are held fixed. The inequalities need not be strict, and equivalent aggregate representations preserve semantics.

claim: Explain the method with an observed request-to-decision trace
scope: Recorded DeepSeek high primary compilation with no catalogue. Equivalent top-four loss notation is checked against the actual generated expression and the reference ledger for 256 candidates and 57 events (14,592 checks); current full-domain execution reproduces its purchase and utility. The earlier observed ticket trace is preserved in Appendix A.4.

claim: Report the primary DeepSeek decisions under Algorithm 1
scope: All 400 retained DeepSeek specifications use the complete-domain evaluator: low 184/200, high 185/200, pooled 369/400. Unsafe=9, false refusal=1, safe completion=186/200, Other=21. All related summaries, template results, figures and intervals use these decisions. Other cohorts retain their stated execution and scoring protocols.
